model_b.description: The image is a statistical pie chart titled 'Favourite Fruits', showing three sectors representing Apple (plain white), Mango (striped), and Banana (dotted), with a corresponding legend on the right. Geometrically, it consists of a circle divided into three sectors by a vertical line segment and a tilted line segment, alongside a rectangular legend box containing three smaller rectangular pattern swatches and text labels. It is a statistical chart rather than a pure geometric diagram, but contains basic geometric entities like circles, line segments, and rectangles.

entities.evidence: A large black circle outline defining the boundary of the pie chart.
A straight vertical line segment starting from the top edge of the circle, passing through the center, and ending at the bottom edge.
A straight tilted line segment starting from the center of the circle and ending on the left boundary, dividing the dotted and striped sectors.
A large black rectangular border enclosing the legend items.
A small plain white rectangle representing the 'Apple' sector pattern.
A small rectangle filled with diagonal stripes representing the 'Mango' sector pattern.
A small rectangle filled with a dotted pattern representing the 'Banana' sector pattern.
The title text 'Favourite Fruits' centered at the top of the image.
The text label 'Apple' next to the plain white rectangle symbol in the legend.
The text label 'Mango' next to the striped rectangle symbol in the legend.
The text label 'Banana' next to the dotted rectangle symbol in the legend.

relationships.evidence: The vertical line segment (e2) and the tilted line segment (e3) meet at the center of the pie chart circle (e1).
The vertical line segment (e2) divides the circle (e1) into two halves, representing the boundary of the Apple sector.
The tilted line segment (e3) divides the left half of the circle (e1) into the Banana and Mango sectors.
The plain white sector corresponds to the plain white rectangle symbol (e5) labeled 'Apple' (e9).
The striped sector corresponds to the striped rectangle symbol (e6) labeled 'Mango' (e10).
The dotted sector corresponds to the dotted rectangle symbol (e7) labeled 'Banana' (e11).
The text label 'Apple' (e9) is placed adjacent to the plain white rectangle symbol (e5) inside the legend box (e4).
The text label 'Mango' (e10) is placed adjacent to the striped rectangle symbol (e6) inside the legend box (e4).
The text label 'Banana' (e11) is placed adjacent to the dotted rectangle symbol (e7) inside the legend box (e4).

uncertainties.note: The exact sector angles are not numerically labeled, so the visual proportions are approximate and represent the relative sizes of the fruits but have no written values.
The image is a statistical pie chart rather than a pure geometric diagram, so geometric relationships are representational rather than theorematic.
